'''2022 MPC Vinny Rossi DS Endor Ops''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Vincent Rossi]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Vincent Rossi]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open EOps Rossi DS 2022 MPC.txt |Download]]
